top_signals.title: Brookfield to Open Doha Office to Deepen Its Middle East Reach
top_signals.summary: Brookfield Asset Management Ltd. is opening an office in Qatar, deepening its presence in the Middle East where many countries are grappling with the economic fallout from the war.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: America by the numbers: How voters feel about the economy, inflation, AI and Trump
top_signals.summary: With the U.S. midterm elections looming, Americans are nearly as gloomy about the economy as they were when the nation was emerging from the pandemic.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: AI debt and French bonds face a stress test — why it may not be over
top_signals.summary: Bond markets are signaling unease over AI financing costs and sovereign debt in parts of Europe. More stress tests are coming.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
